utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. This is case number IT-04-75-PT, the Prosecutor versus Goran Hadzic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Could I have the appearances, please.

utterances.speaker: MS. BAIG
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Laurel Baig for the Prosecution. I'm appearing with Ms. Sarah Clanton; our intern, Camille Franceschi; and our case manager, Sebastiaan van Hooydonk.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you. Yes, Mr. Zivanovic.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. For

utterances.speaker: MR. GORAN HADZIC
utterances.text: Zoran Zivanovic, lead counsel.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you. May I confirm with Mr. Hadzic that he can follow the proceedings in a language he can understand?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I can confirm that I understand you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you. This is the second Status Conference in this case. The purpose of the conference, pursuant to Rule 65 bis (A), is to organise exchanges between the parties so as to ensure the expeditious preparation for trial. It is also to allow Mr. Hadzic the opportunity to raise any issues in relation to his mental and physical condition while in detention. There was a Rule 65 ter Conference held this week, on the 15th of February, at which the parties and the Legal Officer of the Chamber discussed various issues related to the pre-trial preparation of the case. The Chamber has been informed of what transpired at that meeting. I wish to thank the parties for their participation in that Rule 65 ter Conference, and I also commend them for the spirit of co-operation that they have displayed thus far during the pre-trial preparation of this case. I note that the first joint report on agreed facts has been filed. I wish to thank the parties for their timely filing and their continued progress towards reaching agreement on facts pertinent to the trial where possible. I note that the briefing has been completed for the Prosecution's motion seeking to amend the first amended indictment. The Chamber will issue its decision on the motion soon. I acknowledge receipt of three Defence motions of -- for access to confidential materials in various closed cases. After completion of the briefing on these motions, the Chamber will issue its decision as soon as possible. There are also two Defence motions for access to confidential material in ongoing cases, which will be dealt with by the Chambers seized of those cases. I acknowledge receipt of the Prosecution's fourth report on disclosure of the 9th of February. I would now ask the Prosecution to report on the state of Rule 68(i), Rule 68(ii), and Rule 68(A)(ii) disclosure. Mrs. Baig.

utterances.speaker: MS. BAIG
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. And as I report -- as we reported in the fourth report on disclosure, our preparations for completing our disclosure obligations are proceeding efficiently at this stage. We have been making disclosure of relevant and exculpatory documents, both from ongoing searches in the evidence collection and based on the agreement that we have with the Defence to disclose materials disclosed to previous related cases. With regard to 66(A)(ii) disclosure, that is, the witness material, we started in December with disclosing the material relating to proposed expert witnesses for the Prosecution, and we are currently working on preparing similar materials under 66(A)(ii) based on the preliminary witness list that we shared with the Defence in late December, I believe that was the 20th of December. So we're currently in the process of gathering the statements and previous testimony of those witnesses and we plan to disclose those as soon as that project is complete.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: [Microphone not activated]

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Microphone for the Judge, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: I'm sorry. Yes, Mr. Zivanovic, do you have any comments on the proposed guide-lines for the management of the evidence?

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: No, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you. Sorry about that. I skipped a part of what I was supposed to ask. At the last two Rule 65 ter Conferences, guide-lines for the management of evidence during the pre-trial and pre-trial phase -- during the pre-trial and trial phase have been discussed. Before trial commences, the Trial Chamber will issue an order formalising these guide-lines. I would now invite the Prosecution - and I already did for the Defence - to make any comments they wish on the proposed guide-lines for the management of evidence. Mrs. Baig.

utterances.speaker: MS. BAIG
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. And we have made some comments with regard to these guide-lines in writing already, and we've raised a few clarifications in the 65 ter Conference of this week. I believe that those cover all of our concerns. The Chamber is well aware of what the Prosecution's position is on these matters.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: We'll take them into account of course. Thank you, Mrs. Baig. Mr. Zivanovic, we have your position.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: We have no comments.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you very much. At this point I would like to ask Mr. Hadzic whether there are any issues in relation to his case that he would like to raise today. This may include, Mr. Hadzic, issues regarding your mental or physical condition while in detention. And please be assured that we can go into private session for these purposes if you would prefer. Mr. Hadzic, is there anything you would like to ...

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] There is nothing I would like to raise at this moment. Everything is fine.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Hadzic. Are there any other matters that the parties wish to raise today? Mrs. Baig?

utterances.speaker: MS. BAIG
utterances.text: Your Honour, I can just indicate for the record that the Prosecution responses to the five access motions have been filed yesterday and today, so subject to any replies that filing is complete. And we have no other matters to raise. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Mr. Zivanovic?

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Just, I'm aware of two responses of the Prosecution. Maybe I have it today --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: I suppose they will follow indeed, yes. If that is all, thank you, Mr. Zivanovic. And I thank you kindly for your appearances today. I thank the parties for their continuing mutual co-operation in getting this case ready for trial. A Scheduling Order for the next two Rule 65 ter Conferences and the next two Status Conferences has been issued. The next Rule 65 ter Conference will be held on Thursday, 7th of June, at 2.00 p.m.; and the next Status Conference will be held on the 14th of June at 2.30 p.m. in a courtroom to be determined. This Status Conference is now adjourned.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the Status Conference adjourned at 2.43 p.m.
